name: 33 - API - Process Human Handoff Task - Corrected V2

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::BIGINT AS handoff_task_id,
        $3::TEXT AS action,
        $4::TEXT AS actor_name,
        $5::TEXT AS contact_channel,
        $6::TEXT AS note,
        LEAST(
            GREATEST($7::INTEGER, 5),
            10080
        ) AS next_followup_minutes
),

task_context AS (
    SELECT
        task.id AS handoff_task_id,
        task.clinic_id,
        task.patient_id,
        task.appointment_id,
        task.task_type,
        task.source_type,
        task.source_record_id,
        task.priority,
        task.status AS task_status,
        task.reason,
        task.due_at,
        task.assigned_to,
        task.attempt_count,

        clinic.name AS clinic_name,
        clinic.timezone,

        patient.full_name AS patient_name,
        patient.mobile,

        appointment.starts_at,
        appointment.ends_at,
        appointment.status AS appointment_status,
        appointment.google_calendar_event_id,

        doctor.full_name AS doctor_name,
        service.name AS service_name,

        request.action,
        request.actor_name,
        request.contact_channel,
        request.note,
        request.next_followup_minutes

    FROM human_handoff_tasks task

    INNER JOIN request_data request
        ON request.handoff_task_id = task.id

    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.id = task.clinic_id
       AND clinic.name = request.clinic_name

    LEFT JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.id = task.patient_id

    LEFT JOIN appointments appointment
        ON appointment.id = task.appointment_id

    LEFT JOIN doctors doctor
        ON doctor.id = appointment.doctor_id

    LEFT JOIN services service
        ON service.id = appointment.service_id

    LIMIT 1
),

claimed_task AS (
    UPDATE human_handoff_tasks task

    SET
        status = 'in_progress',
        assigned_to = context.actor_name,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM task_context context

    WHERE context.action = 'claim'
      AND context.task_status = 'open'
      AND task.id = context.handoff_task_id

    RETURNING task.id
),

released_task AS (
    UPDATE human_handoff_tasks task

    SET
        status = 'open',
        assigned_to = NULL,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM task_context context

    WHERE context.action = 'release'
      AND context.task_status = 'in_progress'
      AND task.id = context.handoff_task_id

    RETURNING task.id
),

no_answer_task AS (
    UPDATE human_handoff_tasks task

    SET
        status = 'open',
        assigned_to = context.actor_name,

        attempt_count =
            COALESCE(task.attempt_count, 0) + 1,

        last_attempt_at = NOW(),
        last_contact_channel = context.contact_channel,
        last_contact_outcome = 'no_answer',

        due_at = NOW()
            + MAKE_INTERVAL(
                mins => context.next_followup_minutes
            ),

        resolution_note = NULLIF(context.note, ''),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM task_context context

    WHERE context.action = 'mark_no_answer'
      AND context.task_status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
      AND task.id = context.handoff_task_id

    RETURNING
        task.id,
        task.attempt_count,
        task.due_at
),

confirmed_appointment AS (
    UPDATE appointments appointment

    SET
        status = 'confirmed',
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM task_context context

    WHERE context.action = 'resolve_confirmed'
      AND context.task_status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
      AND appointment.id = context.appointment_id
      AND appointment.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
      AND appointment.starts_at > NOW()

    RETURNING appointment.id
),

confirmed_source AS (
    UPDATE appointment_confirmation_requests confirmation

    SET
        status = 'confirmed',
        responded_at = COALESCE(
            confirmation.responded_at,
            NOW()
        ),
        response_note = (
            SELECT NULLIF(note, '')
            FROM request_data
        ),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM task_context context

    INNER JOIN confirmed_appointment appointment
        ON appointment.id = context.appointment_id

    WHERE context.source_type = 'appointment_confirmation'
      AND confirmation.id = context.source_record_id
      AND confirmation.status IN ('pending', 'expired')

    RETURNING confirmation.id
),

resolved_confirmed_task AS (
    UPDATE human_handoff_tasks task

    SET
        status = 'resolved',
        assigned_to = context.actor_name,

        attempt_count =
            COALESCE(task.attempt_count, 0) + 1,

        last_attempt_at = NOW(),
        last_contact_channel = context.contact_channel,
        last_contact_outcome = 'resolved',

        resolution_code = 'patient_confirmed',
        resolution_note = NULLIF(context.note, ''),

        resolved_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM task_context context

    INNER JOIN confirmed_appointment appointment
        ON appointment.id = context.appointment_id

    WHERE task.id = context.handoff_task_id

    RETURNING task.id
),

cancelled_appointment AS (
    UPDATE appointments appointment

    SET
        status = 'cancelled',

        cancellation_reason =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(context.note, ''),
                'لغو نوبت پس از پیگیری منشی انسانی'
            ),

        cancelled_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM task_context context

    WHERE context.action = 'resolve_cancelled'
      AND context.task_status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
      AND appointment.id = context.appointment_id
      AND appointment.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
      AND appointment.starts_at > NOW()

    RETURNING appointment.id
),

cancelled_source AS (
    UPDATE appointment_confirmation_requests confirmation

    SET
        status = 'cancelled',
        responded_at = COALESCE(
            confirmation.responded_at,
            NOW()
        ),
        response_note = (
            SELECT NULLIF(note, '')
            FROM request_data
        ),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM task_context context

    INNER JOIN cancelled_appointment appointment
        ON appointment.id = context.appointment_id

    WHERE context.source_type = 'appointment_confirmation'
      AND confirmation.id = context.source_record_id
      AND confirmation.status IN ('pending', 'expired')

    RETURNING confirmation.id
),

resolved_cancelled_task AS (
    UPDATE human_handoff_tasks task

    SET
        status = 'resolved',
        assigned_to = context.actor_name,

        attempt_count =
            COALESCE(task.attempt_count, 0) + 1,

        last_attempt_at = NOW(),
        last_contact_channel = context.contact_channel,
        last_contact_outcome = 'resolved',

        resolution_code = 'appointment_cancelled',
        resolution_note = NULLIF(context.note, ''),

        resolved_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM task_context context

    INNER JOIN cancelled_appointment appointment
        ON appointment.id = context.appointment_id

    WHERE task.id = context.handoff_task_id

    RETURNING task.id
),

reschedule_source AS (
    UPDATE appointment_confirmation_requests confirmation

    SET
        status = 'reschedule_requested',
        responded_at = COALESCE(
            confirmation.responded_at,
            NOW()
        ),
        response_note = context.note,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM task_context context

    WHERE context.action = 'resolve_reschedule'
      AND context.task_status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
      AND context.source_type = 'appointment_confirmation'
      AND confirmation.id = context.source_record_id
      AND confirmation.status IN ('pending', 'expired')
      AND context.appointment_status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
      AND context.starts_at > NOW()

    RETURNING confirmation.id
),

resolved_reschedule_task AS (
    UPDATE human_handoff_tasks task

    SET
        status = 'resolved',
        assigned_to = context.actor_name,

        attempt_count =
            COALESCE(task.attempt_count, 0) + 1,

        last_attempt_at = NOW(),
        last_contact_channel = context.contact_channel,
        last_contact_outcome = 'resolved',

        resolution_code = 'reschedule_requested',
        resolution_note = NULLIF(context.note, ''),

        resolved_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM task_context context

    INNER JOIN reschedule_source source
        ON TRUE

    WHERE task.id = context.handoff_task_id

    RETURNING task.id
),

closed_no_action_task AS (
    UPDATE human_handoff_tasks task

    SET
        status = 'resolved',
        assigned_to = context.actor_name,

        resolution_code = 'no_action_needed',
        resolution_note = NULLIF(context.note, ''),

        resolved_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM task_context context

    WHERE context.action = 'close_no_action'
      AND context.task_status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
      AND task.id = context.handoff_task_id

    RETURNING task.id
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM task_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN (
            SELECT task_status
            FROM task_context
        ) IN ('resolved', 'cancelled')
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN request.action = 'claim'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM claimed_task
             )
            THEN TRUE

        WHEN request.action = 'release'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM released_task
             )
            THEN TRUE

        WHEN request.action = 'mark_no_answer'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM no_answer_task
             )
            THEN TRUE

        WHEN request.action = 'resolve_confirmed'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM resolved_confirmed_task
             )
            THEN TRUE

        WHEN request.action = 'resolve_cancelled'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM resolved_cancelled_task
             )
            THEN TRUE

        WHEN request.action = 'resolve_reschedule'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM resolved_reschedule_task
             )
            THEN TRUE

        WHEN request.action = 'close_no_action'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM closed_no_action_task
             )
            THEN TRUE

        ELSE FALSE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM task_context
        )
            THEN 'handoff_task_not_found'

        WHEN (
            SELECT task_status
            FROM task_context
        ) IN ('resolved', 'cancelled')
            THEN 'handoff_task_closed'

        WHEN request.action = 'claim'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM claimed_task
             )
            THEN 'handoff_task_claimed'

        WHEN request.action = 'release'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM released_task
             )
            THEN 'handoff_task_released'

        WHEN request.action = 'mark_no_answer'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM no_answer_task
             )
            THEN 'no_answer_recorded'

        WHEN request.action = 'resolve_confirmed'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM resolved_confirmed_task
             )
            THEN 'patient_confirmed'

        WHEN request.action = 'resolve_cancelled'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM resolved_cancelled_task
             )
            THEN 'appointment_cancelled'

        WHEN request.action = 'resolve_reschedule'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM resolved_reschedule_task
             )
            THEN 'reschedule_requested'

        WHEN request.action = 'close_no_action'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM closed_no_action_task
             )
            THEN 'handoff_closed_no_action'

        ELSE 'handoff_action_conflict'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM task_context
        )
            THEN 'تسک مطابق شناسه و کلینیک واردشده پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN (
            SELECT task_status
            FROM task_context
        ) IN ('resolved', 'cancelled')
            THEN 'این تسک قبلاً بسته شده است.'

        WHEN request.action = 'claim'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM claimed_task
             )
            THEN 'تسک به منشی انتخاب‌شده تخصیص یافت.'

        WHEN request.action = 'release'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM released_task
             )
            THEN 'تسک آزاد شد و به صف عمومی بازگشت.'

        WHEN request.action = 'mark_no_answer'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM no_answer_task
             )
            THEN 'عدم پاسخ بیمار ثبت و زمان پیگیری بعدی تعیین شد.'

        WHEN request.action = 'resolve_confirmed'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM resolved_confirmed_task
             )
            THEN 'حضور بیمار توسط منشی تأیید و تسک بسته شد.'

        WHEN request.action = 'resolve_cancelled'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM resolved_cancelled_task
             )
            THEN 'نوبت بیمار لغو و تسک بسته شد.'

        WHEN request.action = 'resolve_reschedule'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM resolved_reschedule_task
             )
            THEN 'درخواست جابه‌جایی بیمار ثبت و تسک بسته شد.'

        WHEN request.action = 'close_no_action'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM closed_no_action_task
             )
            THEN 'تسک بدون نیاز به اقدام بیشتر بسته شد.'

        ELSE 'وضعیت تسک یا نوبت در فاصله بررسی تا ثبت اقدام تغییر کرده است.'
    END AS message,

    request.action,

    (
        SELECT handoff_task_id
        FROM task_context
    ) AS handoff_task_id,

    (
        SELECT appointment_id
        FROM task_context
    ) AS appointment_id,

    (
        SELECT patient_name
        FROM task_context
    ) AS patient_name,

    (
        SELECT mobile
        FROM task_context
    ) AS mobile,

    (
        SELECT doctor_name
        FROM task_context
    ) AS doctor_name,

    (
        SELECT service_name
        FROM task_context
    ) AS service_name,

    (
        SELECT google_calendar_event_id
        FROM task_context
    ) AS google_calendar_event_id,

    (
        SELECT attempt_count
        FROM no_answer_task
    ) AS attempt_count,

    (
        SELECT due_at
        FROM no_answer_task
    ) AS next_due_at,

    CASE
        WHEN request.action = 'resolve_cancelled'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM resolved_cancelled_task
             )
            THEN 'delete'

        WHEN request.action = 'resolve_reschedule'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM resolved_reschedule_task
             )
            THEN 'find_available_slots'

        ELSE 'none'
    END AS next_action

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## پردازش تسک منشی

handoff_task_id را از Workflow شماره 32 بردار.

**actionهای مجاز:**
- claim: تخصیص تسک به منشی
- release: بازگرداندن تسک به صف عمومی
- mark_no_answer: ثبت عدم پاسخ و زمان پیگیری بعدی
- resolve_confirmed: تأیید حضور بیمار
- resolve_cancelled: لغو نوبت و حذف Calendar
- resolve_reschedule: ثبت درخواست جابه‌جایی
- close_no_action: بستن بدون اقدام بیشتر

مقدار پیش‌فرض روی claim قرار دارد.

اصلاح V2:
در صورت نبود Calendar Event، وضعیت not_present برگردانده می‌شود.
